{{Top|leg}}
'''Fungus crackers''' were snacks that were available for consumption on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Protocol droid/Legends|Protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] once served fungus crackers and an assortment of geometrically-shaped [[Cheese/Legends|cheeses]] to [[Mara Jade Skywalker]], while she and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|her husband]] visited the new apartment of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].
